segments.name: Beverage alcohol e-commerce
segments.description: Sells spirits, wines and tequila online through CWSpirits.com and SWOL Tequila, and markets alcohol brands for external clients.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that there is only one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Online shoppers buy spirits, wines and tequila from the company, and external brands pay for marketing strategies such as ads and influencer campaigns.
revenueModel.evidence: To date, our core business includes e-commerce sales in the United States through CWSpirits.com, growing our in-house tequila brand SWOL Tequila, and developing marketing strategies for external brands.
